route.name: Zaandam - Zaanse Schans - Alkmaar (via Schermer) 48 km (before 15 April) ENG 2026 (white label)

course_points.n: Turn right onto A.F. de Savornin Lohmanstraat
Turn right; do not follow junction network
At roundabout take exit 3 to junction 72
Keep right; you can ignore the traffic light
Go straight, ignore the junction sign
Go left on parallel road to junction 92
